provenance_note: All client, vendor, and human-contact data excluded. Business name and tagline specifics stripped; business type retained as industry vertical.

classification.illumination_scope: cabinet only; structure and columns unlit

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A landscape-style monument where an illuminated brand cabinet hangs from a rough-sawn redwood trellis spanning two stone-clad columns. It reads as a built architectural structure rather than a single sign panel, tying the brand to a rustic, agricultural setting.
knowledge.rationale: Suspending a serviceable metal cabinet inside a timber-and-stone structure gets a warm, site-rooted architectural read while keeping the lit, weatherable, changeable part of the sign as a conventional fabricated cabinet.
knowledge.tradeoffs: Three trades in one sign (timber, masonry, metal fabrication) raises cost and coordination, but produces a distinctive premium result a single cabinet on a pole cannot.
knowledge.when_to_use: Brands wanting a rustic, established, place-rooted identity, especially against natural or agricultural site context.

structure.function: primary overhead structure spanning the columns; carries the suspended cabinet
structure.construction: rough-sawn redwood trellis with a double 2in x 10in redwood center beam

structure.function: suspend the cabinet from the trellis
structure.construction: fabricated aluminum tube support brackets styled to resemble I-beams, with 1/4in aluminum mounting plates
6in deep fabricated aluminum cabinet; stencil-cut aluminum face backed with 3/4in clear acrylic push-thru letterforms

face.decoration: translucent vinyl on push-thru letter faces

structure.function: structural supports and visual base; carry the trellis
structure.construction: fabricated aluminum frame sheathed in exterior cement backer board, finished with stone veneer
structure.finish: stone veneer to match building foundation

utilities.power: dedicated 120V/20A sign circuit, no other load

craft_observations: Hangers styled as I-beams make the suspension itself a design feature rather than hidden hardware.
Stone veneer matched to the building foundation ties the sign to its architecture, a strong site-fit move.
Material palette (redwood, stone, bronze metal, red cabinet) is coherent and rooted to a rustic agricultural context.

aesthetic_notes.note: Reads as a built gateway structure, warmer and more permanent than a standard cabinet monument.

open_items: Sign attachment and support structure pending structural engineering review

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on construction and materials, medium on exact dimensions

schema_strain_log.key_modeling_addition: Intra-sign mounting relationships: a component can be mounted to or suspended from another component in the same sign, not just to the ground. The structure array needs to express these dependencies.
schema_strain_log.shape_finding: Did NOT break the record shape. First sign with non-metal structural materials (timber, stone) and a layered cladding buildup. Still does not test the vehicle-wrap shape risk.
